what: floating capsule restyled to the same design system as the main app
before: dark navy ball and card with a cyan glow border and one blue button, which no longer matched the light-first single-colour UI

after.collapsed: card-coloured circle, 1 dp stroke, ink mark, 4 dp elevation, green status dot kept for state
after.expanded: white/dark card at 18 dp radius with 1 dp stroke and 8 dp elevation, ink title, muted collapse action, body-coloured rows
after.actions: three secondary chips (实时拾音 / 真机视觉 / PTT 按键) at 40 dp plus one filled primary (主系统)
after.waveform: rounded light-grey bars instead of saturated cyan

dark_mode: the service reads the theme when it attaches; the primary button flips to near-white with ink text so it stays visible on the dark card
known_limit: the overlay keeps the theme it was created with; toggling system dark mode while the capsule is open does not restyle it until it is hidden and shown again
